title: Benchmark Evidence Record
description: Schema for AURA benchmark evidence records. Each record classifies one provider/model/dataset run against defined evidence criteria.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this benchmark run.

dataset_type.description: Type of dataset used. 'none' only for planned runs.

provider.description: AI provider used (e.g., chrome_ai, ollama, gemini).

model_version.description: Model version or hash if known.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run started.

completed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run completed.

classification.description: Evidence classification per Phase 8 L5 criteria.

failure_reason.description: Reason for failure if status is not 'completed'.

json_valid.description: Whether the model output is valid JSON.

script_generated.description: Whether a Python cleaning script was generated.

script_valid.description: Whether the generated script passes structural validation.

hallucination_flags.description: List of hallucination flags detected (phantom columns, unsupported claims, etc.).

unsupported_claims_count.description: Number of unsupported claims detected in output.

evidence_files.description: List of evidence file paths produced by this run.

claims_allowed.description: Claims that are permitted based on classification level.

claims_forbidden.description: Claims that must NOT be made based on classification level.

reviewer_notes.description: Optional notes from human reviewer or acceptance criteria applied.
